description: Figure 1 illustrates the distribution of content types within the DODa dataset. The pie chart is divided into six slices, representing different categories of content. The slice labeled “Numeric Categories (e.g., Prod. Economy)” is yellow and comprises approximately 28% of the total. The “Annotated Values of a Word, Sentence” slice is green and represents roughly 23%. A blue slice, labeled “Translated Sentences,” accounts for approximately 18% of the chart. The slice for “Extra – Supplemental Data” is a lighter shade of blue and appears to be around 11%. “Reading Translations” is represented by a purple slice, making up about 10% of the chart. Finally, the smallest slice, labeled “Rooting Translations,” is orange and represents approximately 9% of the total. The chart includes a legend identifying each color with its corresponding content type, and percentage labels are displayed inside each slice. The slices are visually ordered in a clockwise direction, starting with the largest and proceeding to the smallest.
